paite: Johan sang in Jesu'n nungzui tamzaw abawl a, tam abaptis zaw chih Pharisaite'n aza uh chih Toupa'n atheih in.
heading: Jesu Leh Samari Numei
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

paite: (Jesu hial in zaw abaptis kei a, anungzuite'n abaptis zaw zel uh),
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

paite: Judia gam paisan in, Galili gam ah akik nawnta hi.
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

paite: Huchi in Samaria gam tawn a pai akul hi.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

paite: Huchi in Samaria gam khua khat, Saikar achih uh, Jakob in atapa Joseph kiang a mun apiakna kiang ahong tung hi.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

paite: Huai ah Jakob tuileh a-om hi. Huchi in Jesu apaigim ziak in tuileh gei ah atu a; huai hun dak gukna khawng ahi.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

paite: Huchi in Samari numei khat tui tawi in ahong kuan a, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Dawn ding hon pia in," achi hi.
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

paite: (Anungzuite lah nek ding lei in khua ah ahoh ngal ua).
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

paite: Huchi in Samari numei in akiang ah, "Nang Juda mi hi chin a, kei Samari numei hi ing a, bangchidan a ka kiang a dawn ding hon ngen na hia? achi hi. Judate'n lah Samari mite bangmah in angai ngal kei ua," achi hi.
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Pathian thilthawnpiak leh dawn ding hon pia in, na kiang a chipa thei leteh zaw nang akiang a ngen zaw ding hi chin a, ama'n tuihing hon pe ding hiven," achi hi.
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

paite: Huan numei in akiang ah, "Pu, akhaikhiakna ding bangmah lah na nei kei a, tuileh athukthuk toh, koi a kipan in ahia huai tuihing na muh ding?
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

paite: Ka pu uh Jakob sang in na thupizaw a hia? Ama'n hiai tuileh hon pia a, amah leh atate leh agante'n leng adawn uhi,” achi hi.
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuapeuh hiai tui dawn adangtak nawn ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

paite: "Kuapeuh akiang a ka piak ding tui dawn bel, dangtak nawn ngei lou ding a; akiang a tui ka piak ding pen amah ah tui nak ahong phulkhe ding a, tangtawn hinpha a kikhohtou ding ahi," achi hi.
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

paite: Huan numei in akiang ah, "Pu, huai tui hon pe ve, ka dangtak nawnlouhna ding leh hiai tantan a tui tawi ding a ka hong kuanlouhna ding in," achi hi.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pai inla, na pasal va sam inla, hiai ah hong kik nawn in,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, “Pasal ka nei sam a," chi in adawng hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pasal ka nei sam a, na chih zaw, na chi dik ve;
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

paite: pasal nga na neita a, tua na neihpa pen na pasal ahi kei him ahi, hiai thu na chi dik ve,” achi hi.
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, "Pu, zawlnei na hi chih ka thei hi.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

paite: Kou pipute'n hiai tang ah Pathian abe zel ua; nou bel mihing in Pathian abiakna mun ding Jerusalem khua ahi, na chi sese ua," achi hi.
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, kei hon gingta in, hiai tang chitchiat lou leh Jerusalem khua chitchiat lou ah leng Pa na biak hun uh atungta hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

paite: Nou na theih louhpi uh na be nak ua, kou zaw ka theih uh ka bia uh; hotdamna lah Judate a kipan ahi ngal a.
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

paite: Himahleh Pathian be taktakte'n kha leh thutak a Pa abiak hun uh tung ding ahita, tu in leng atung lel hi, Pa'n huchibang mi abemi ding in azong hi.
english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

paite: Pathian zaw Kha ahi a, abemite'n kha leh thutak a abiak ngeingei ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, "Messia, Khrist akichi, ahong pai ding chih ka thei, amah ahong pai chiang in bangkim ahon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Keimah nang hon houpihpa, huai amah ka hi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

paite: Huan huai lai in anungzuite ahong pai ua, numei ahoupih lamdang asa mahmah uhi; himahleh kuamah in, "Bang zong na hia? Bangziak a numei houpih?" achi kei uh.
heading: Nungzuite Thuhilhna
english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

paite: Numei in atuibel apaisan a, khua ah ava pai a, mite kiang ah,
english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

paite: "Ка thilhih peuh hon hilh zel mi khat a-om, hong unla, en dih uh; Khrist ahihtheih tuak na hiam?" achi hi.
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

paite: Amaute khua a kipan ahong pawt ua, akiang lam azuanta uhi.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

paite: Huai kal in nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ne in," achi uhi.
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Na theih louh uh nek ding an ka nei," achi hi.
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

paite: Huan nungzuite akihou ua, "Anek ding mi'n ahon tawi ua eita maw?" akichi uhi.
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah agen a, "Hon sawlpa deihlam hihleh, ama nna sep zoh ding ka an ahi.
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

paite: Nou, buhlakna ding kha li a-om lai, na chi uh hilou hia? Ngai un ka hon hilh ahi, dak unla loute en un, tu mahmah in lak ding in amin ahi.
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

paite: Alapa'n loh amu a, tangtawn hinna ding in gah ala hi, huchi a atuhpa leh alapa akipah tuaktheihna ding un.
english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

paite: Khat in atuh a, midang in ala chih thu hiai ah adik hi.
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

paite: Na sepgim louh uh at dia hon sawl ka hi; midang in asem ua, nou asepsa uh na sunzom uh ahi," achi hi.
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

paite: Huan numei in, "Ka thilhih peuh hon hilh zel," chi a atheihsak thu ziak in huai khua a om Samari mi tampi in Jesu agingta uhi.
heading: Samarite Thuhilhna
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu kiang ah Samari mite ahong pai ua, akiang ua om ding in akhou ngutngut ua; huchi in huai ah ni nih ataam hi.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

paite: Huan midang tampi in amah thu ziak in agingta samta uhi.
english: Many more believed because of his word.

paite: Amau numei kiang ah, "Tu in zaw na thugen ziak a gingta ka hi kei uh; koumau ngei in athu ka za ua, hiai mipa Khrist, khovel Hondampa ngei ahi chih ka theita uh," achi uhi.
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

paite: Huan ni nih nung in huai a pan pawt in, Galili gam ah apaita hi.
heading: Kapernaum Khua A Kumpi Milian Tapa Hihdamna
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

paite: Jesu ngei in, zawlnei zaw ama kholam ah pahtawi in a-om ngei kei chih atheihpih hi.
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

paite: Huchi in Galili gam ahong tun in Galili gam mite'n ana kipahpih ua, Jerusalem a ankuanglui lai a athilhih tengteng amuh tak ziak un; amau mah leng ankuangluina ah ahoh sam uhi.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

paite: Galili gam a Kana khua, tui uain asuahsakna mun ahong tung nawnta hi. Kumpi milian kuahiam a-om a, Kapernaum ah atapa achina hi.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

paite: Judia gam a kipan Galili gam ah Jesu ahong chih azak in akiang ah ahohtou a, va hohsuk a atapa si dekdek hihdam ding in achial hi.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na muh kei uleh na gingta kei hial ding uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

paite: Huan Kumpi milian in akiang ah, "Pu, ka ta asih ma in hong suk mai in," achi hi.
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pai nawnta in, na tapa adamta," achi hi. Huai mipa'n, Jesu'n akiang a thu agen agingta a, apaita hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

paite: Apaisuk lai in asikhate'n ana dawn ua, "Na tapa adamta," ana chi uhi.
english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah adam tung lai adong hi. Amau akiang ah, "Zan in dak sagihna ah akhosik ahong daita hi," achi uhi.
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

paite: Naupang pa'n Jesu'n akiang a, "Na tapa adamta hi,” achih lai ahi chih atheita a; amah leh a-inkuanpihte'n avek un, agingtata uhi.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

paite: Hiai Judia gam a kipan Galili gam a ahong a Jesu thillamdang hih anihveina ahi.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
